He'll also relinquish his roles as chief compliance officer, treasurer, and secretary on that same date. Steenkamp will continue to serve in a consulting capacity following the transition. He will remain on the company's board and will serve as the CFO of the company's SBIC subsidiaries.
Christine Ramdihal to chief accounting officer and treasurer and will serve as the company's principal financial officer.
Rochelle Kracoff to chief compliance officer and secretary.
James Soltesz to investment manager and vice president of Capital Markets.
stock edged down 0.2% in after-hours trading.
